text:
Happy 72nd Birthday to my Dad 🥳

This was an incredible gift to give my Dad last year. He's been in the guardian role on a dozen @HonorFlightNE's honoring vets.

The cutoff for being a guardian is 70 years old, and he was truly bummed.

I told him they made an exception due to our relationship with @Delta, as they were having some of their own veterans on board and he'd be able to guardian one last time!

Little did he know, we flipped the script. He was going on the flight as a veteran this time. He didn't find out until he got his shirt (grey = veteran / blue = guardian).

Also, my Uncle was on the same flight. Little did he know, his son flew in from Texas to be his guardian. He hadn't seen him in over a year and didn't find out who is guardian would be until that morning.

Epic trip!
🫡
Best to watch these before June 4th! All about being in the proper mindset for success!

Happy to see this come to fruition. It's been a minute since we had updated things, and for those who are in the room, you see them adding value each day. Nice to get into their heads and get a feel for the thought process behind the thesis. Those in chat may look at a comment or two and not grasp a particular concept or short hand - but, not anymore.

Stan @CorleoneOffer is always late "letting others pay for the information first" and once everyone gives up, that's his sign for an entry. He gives killer weekly group calls and has more patience than I do LOL.

Chris @Chris_J_Lance is always adding value add on the macro environment and truly shines on days like today. FOMC days or MOPEX. Trades you may not typically consider but once presented, makes sense. I've learned a lot from him. And you guys see him every Sunday now.

Judah @DividedChamp used to frustrate me sometimes when I'd be fading a name and he's always talking about price coming into support and how it should bounce there, meanwhile I'm hoping for one more leg down. The point being he zooms out more, and when macro trends meet intraday trends he notes it. It's useful.

Nick @KfirCapital is a lot like the old me, in and out often, probably working too hard some days BUT we align and overlap on so many trade ideas. It's really nice to have another set of similar ideas/eyes in the room.

Hoping to continually extract solid set ups from solid traders so there's always an "on" market somewhere even when your style may not be hitting. Not about trading everything, just about expanding the toolbelt and being versatile. And, it's about who do you sync with? What strategy fits your personality?

Great work guys!

text: Entire market is acting like that $CAR $AXTI topping action day when the trade is so obvious but they keep going for the liquidity hunt (ie: clean fade set up, random swipes to work out size) until the bids are gone and the supply remains. No one wants to sell yet because it's worked so well, but damn does it feel like we're hanging by a thread.

On a day like today it's best not to try to time a market fade best to pick up the pieces later if it actually cracks.

You can waste your day trying to get the right entry and anticipate it but the point w/ $CAR etc. when the trade is right the trade is right, the pops are met w/ immediate fails and you never have enough.

So far $SNDK $MU were focus names and $BE presented those opportunities today. Best thing for me take a step back and wait for it to prove otherwise if your head is down too much you'll get too biased.

$732 on $SPY gets me real interested on a macro level, until then expect the same ol' whipsaw as we saw on $CAR or even quantum for that matter.

"the best trades don't look back" as @TheOneLanceB says.

Market can feel this way for longer than you think. Just about identifying the right targets if/when the set up occurs so you can react without thinking too much.
